# Person fixture

`astronaut.png` is the unmodified scikit-image v0.25.2 astronaut sample:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png

NASA photograph of Eileen Collins. Scikit-image documents it as public domain,
with no known copyright restrictions:
https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Bundled so repeated face/segmentation checks need no network or personal images.
